title: A four-qubit criterion for entropy minimax duality: Minimality, sharp Renyi threshold and a W-state counterexample
abstract: We characterize continuous strictly increasing scalar qubit entropies for which support-radial minimax duality holds on every multiqubit orbit closure: universal validity is equivalent to concavity, and the four-qubit W state is a complete test. Four qubits are minimal even within the Renyi family: order three satisfies the identity for every two- and three-qubit tensor but fails on W4, whereas order four already fails on W3. The sharp universal binary Renyi range is 0<alpha<=2. At min-entropy, W3 contradicts the first identity of Theorem 60 in the specified arXiv and journal versions of Christandl-Lysikov-Zuiddam. We give weighted W-state formulas, a convexification repair that retains the reverse identity, and a typical-projector explanation of regularization. Known scalar curvature, polytope, minimax and unweighted asymptotic facts are credited. Priority remains open.
